editorial:
Imagine trying to balance your own dreams while being the glue that holds your family together. You will really feel for Da-bin, a high schooler who spends his days making sure his sister, Eun-seo, gets to school safely because she is hard of hearing. The whole movie has a quiet, cozy, but sad feeling to it. You get to see the stress of a teenager who just wants a normal life and a romantic trip with his girlfriend, but he is stuck dealing with adult problems. It is a story about love, sacrifice, and how hard it is to grow up when you have people relying on you.

The acting is the best part here because the chemistry between the siblings feels totally real. While the story moves a bit slow at times, the emotional payoff is worth the wait. If you like stories that make you cry and think about your own family, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the beautiful winter scenery. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call since the colors are so crisp.
endingExplained: In the end, Da-bin realizes that his bond with Eun-seo is more important than the exchange trip. He decides to give up his dream trip and uses the money he earned at the motel to help his sister with her medical needs. He does not go away, and instead, he finds peace in staying home. The movie ends with a sweet scene of the two siblings walking to school together, showing they are stronger as a team.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves touching family stories and coming-of-age dramas.
